conclusions: The six starts exhaust unchanged 150-iteration budgets after early interval escapes; the last 20 iterations have no restarts or witness changes.

Terminal curvature inflation 256 or 512, repeated half-inflation retries, tiny surrogate steps and remaining node residuals identify high-curvature near-stagnation; no acceptance tolerance should be relaxed.
The 1e-3 cap constrains early escapes but does not explain terminal nonconvergence; this replay does not support increasing it or raising the iteration budget.
Finite plateau proposal evaluation dominates measured audits. Signed scanning is 6.7% of audit time; removing repeated likelihood work is better supported than prioritizing scan compilation.
